text:
Ava: Quick non-work question — what's the weirdest or most unexpected thing you hide in your desk drawer? Asking for a friend :joy:
Marcus: A tiny emergency sewing kit + spare button. Saved me twice.
Priya: A foil-wrapped granola bar (past its "best by" but still heroic) :face_with_hand_over_mouth:
Tom: USB drive with my most embarrassing karaoke playlist. Don't open it.
Katherine: Rubber duck (for stress squeaks) :duck: (yes, it's squeaky)
Marcus: Also a small stash of charger cables labeled with tiny washi tape :nerd_face:
Ava: @Tom please share the karaoke playlist in #random if you dare :laughing:
coffee-bot: Reminder: free snacks in kitchen until 3pm :coffee:
Priya: I once found a handwritten list of 3pm snack thefts from 2019... still in the drawer :eyes:
Katherine: Winner for best story — prize is one rubber duck selfie from me :trophy:
Ava: This is excellent. Next question: who keeps a tiny plant? I'm low on desk greenery
Tom: I do! Succulent named 'Margaret' :seedling:
Marcus: Succulent gang :raised_hands:
Ava: Thanks all — love these little glimpses :heart:
